title: Qualify validators before they gate completion
narrative: Before a schema validator gates done, known-good, known-bad, and missing fixtures must run — including a weak always-pass mutant that must fail qualification. Judge scores alone cannot complete a task (see `fangore_refund_verdict`).
implementation:
`VerificationOracle` / `verify_node` define completion evidence; `qualify_validator` / `validator_qualified` reject always-pass mutants. Judge quality signals remain supplementary to evidence checks.

Covers: VER-01, VER-04.
